reviews.author: Ha P.
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Cape Lookout Campground! The best part is the location—just a short walk to the beach, making it so easy to enjoy the ocean anytime.

We also really appreciated how clean the restrooms were. The campground is peaceful, well-kept, and perfect for a relaxing getaway. We’d definitely come back!

reviews.author: Jamie T.
reviews.text: I absolutely love Cape lookout. They have many very large sites that are full hookup. Cabins, yurts. Make sure you make reservations pretty far in advanced. They are usually very busy. Weekdays not so much, but once summer hits it's very busy. Absolutely beautiful beaches that are close. Great camp hosts. Showers bathrooms. Water spigots everywhere. One of my favorite places.

reviews.author: D. K.
reviews.text: Always liked it. Staff is ways courteous. Been coming once a year for 8 years. Unfortunate that they started inflating the price by 25% + to anyone coming from out of state. This is why I only give it 4 out of 5 stars.

reviews.author: She A.
reviews.text:
Cape Lookout has well equipped day use area. Some picnic tables are more accessible than others.

There is plenty of parking.

The bathrooms were well maintained. The path to the bathrooms is paved.

Access to the water is down a dirt trail below the picnic area.

reviews.author: Emily P.
reviews.text: Definitely one of the best state park campgrounds we have stayed at. Right on the beautiful beach at Cape Lookout - there is six miles of beautiful beach for walking and relaxing, and the whales came to play every evening we were there. They were so close you could see them from the beach! We had a full hookup site for our trailer but there are a range of tent, RV and varying hookups available across the campground. Many of the camping sites had a great privacy hedge between the sites - felt like we had a little private garden of our own. Definitely a highlight of our trip down the Oregon coast!
